scripts.firebase:emulators: npx -y firebase-tools@latest --config firebase.json emulators:start --project demo-memocard --only auth,firestore --import=.firebase-data --export-on-exit=.firebase-data
scripts.test:all: npx -y firebase-tools@latest --config firebase.test.json emulators:exec --project demo-memocard --only firestore "vitest run"
scripts.test:rules: npx -y firebase-tools@latest --config firebase.test.json emulators:exec --project demo-memocard --only firestore "vitest run tests/firestore.rules.test.ts"
